symptom: The deny-only caller-supplied verifier response was first snapshotted after building the independent-proof request. A descriptor proxy in envelope preflight could change a mismatching requestBindingDigest or a nested correction revision digest to a matching value before response capture, reporting responseMetadataConsistent=true for a different entry-time response. No independent verification or scoring authority was granted.
lesson: A complete request-binding digest cannot prevent a caller-owned response from being silently replaced during unrelated request preflight if the response is read only afterward. Nested revision-digest arrays must be detached at the same early boundary as scalar response fields.
guardrail: Pin strict own-data-descriptor response fields and an indexed copy of the complete revision digest array before building the untrusted request. Preserve REQUEST_NOT_READY precedence for invalid requests, reject mismatched entry-time claims, and use phase-triggered regressions that prove both scalar and nested mutations executed. Keep independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false.
